summary: Iteration 36 — Navbar 'Jeux' dropdown + Mots Fléchés v2 (non-square grids, Mistral nightly generator, admin trigger). fleches_mistral.MAX_GENERATED=30 with pruning by oldest created_at — bounded.
daily_email.py registers CronTrigger 04:30 Paris for fleches_generate_nightly, non-overlapping with wordsearch(03:30) and charades(04:00) — good.
GamesDropdown handles Escape + outside click, cleans up listeners on close (deps [open]).
MotsFleches.jsx uses grid.cols || grid.size for gridTemplateColumns and moveCursor/filledCount handle rows/cols — verified rendering a Mistral non-square grid with 24 letter + 12 block cells.
Mobile drawer intentionally kept flat (per requirements) — verified all 4 mobile-nav-<game> testids present at 360x760.
